sql: SELECT T1.title FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.keyword = 'laundering money'
SELECT SUM(T2.votes) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Vote T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Cherished'

SELECT T2.role FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id JOIN Person T3 ON T3.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T1.title = 'Cherished' AND T3.name = 'Park Dietz' AND T2.credited = 'true'
SELECT T1.credited FROM Credit T1 JOIN Person T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Anthony Azzara' AND T1.episode_id = 'tt0629204'
SELECT COUNT(T2.role) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.season = 9 AND T1.episode = 17 AND T2.credited = 'true'
SELECT T1.role FROM Credit T1 JOIN Person T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Joseph Blair'
SELECT air_date FROM Episode ORDER BY votes DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.title = 'Refuge: Part 1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.title = 'Shield' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id
SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Shield'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.category = 'Cast' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.episode_id) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.season = 9
SELECT T2.keyword FROM Episode T1 JOIN Keyword T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.episode_id = (SELECT episode_id FROM Episode ORDER BY votes DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)

SELECT T1.organization FROM Award T1 JOIN Person T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Constantine Makris' AND T1.result = 'Winner' GROUP BY T1.organization ORDER BY COUNT(T1.award_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T2.person_id) FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.title = 'Admissions' AND T2.credited = 'false'
SELECT T1.title FROM Episode T1 JOIN Credit T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.category = 'Art Department' GROUP BY T1.episode_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.person_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.role) FROM Credit T1 JOIN Person T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Julia Roberts'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.episode_id FROM Award T1 WHERE T1.series = 'Law and Order' AND T1.award_category LIKE 'Primetime Emmy%' AND T1.result = 'Nominee'
SELECT birth_place, birth_region FROM Person WHERE birth_name = 'Rene Chenevert Balcer'
